notes: Phase 6 (docs/dynamic-layer.md section 7) Python T2 for the hybrid configuration: repos whose source edits make the static layer widen through name-based imports (Python-Markdown extensions by name, Pygments lexers/formatters/styles by name, Werkzeug's lazy imports). Root defaults to D:/bench/bgraph-eval/t2/python-dyn; same layout and oracle rules as t2-python.json (full clones, core.autocrlf=false, detached at R; venv-<dir> made with `uv venv --python 3.13` and the `install` command; oracle.jsonl). Mutants are generated only in source files whose modification widens (`bgraph-eval t2dyn --prepare` writes mutants-<dir>.json before `bgraph-eval t2 --ecosystem python --dir ... --manifest evalkit/manifest/t2-python-dyn.json --run-tests` builds the oracle). Every mutant modifies an existing .py file, so the dynamic layer's guards allow narrowing.

repos.name: Python-Markdown/markdown
repos.install: uv pip install --python venv-markdown/Scripts/python.exe -e markdown pytest coverage pyyaml pygments
repos.covers: markdown/ (core + extensions loaded by name with importlib), tests/ (unittest suites collected by pytest; ~8 s)

repos.name: pygments/pygments
repos.install: uv pip install --python venv-pygments/Scripts/python.exe -e pygments "pytest~=8.2" wcag-contrast-ratio
repos.covers: pygments/ (lexers, formatters, styles and filters loaded by name), tests/ (34 test files incl. golden example files; ~50 s)

repos.name: pallets/werkzeug
repos.install: uv pip install --python venv-werkzeug/Scripts/python.exe -e werkzeug cffi cryptography ephemeral-port-reserve pytest pytest-timeout watchdog
repos.covers: src/werkzeug (routing, middleware: edits widen through lazy imports), tests/ (27 test files, dev-server tests spawn processes; ~27 s)
